versions.name: Spotify Lyrics
versions.description: See your song lyrics in real time

about:
# <c-63e65e>Sp</c><c-6ae665>ot</c><c-71e66c>if</c><c-79e874>y Ly</c><c-82e87d>ri</c><c-94e890>cs</c>

This mod brings real time lyrics like in spotify to geometry dash

You can resize the lyrics window and move it wherever you want

To close the lyrics window the default keybind is Ctrl + L but you can change it in settings

* Not all songs will have lyrics
* Only tested with the windows spotify app, anything else might not work as expected, if (for example) seeking doesnt work for you even on spotify, idk what to tell u
